summary: Seven games were played. Luka Dončić scored 52 in the Lakers' 132-123 win at Utah, Indiana beat Brooklyn 136-109, and Minnesota led Toronto by as many as 32 in a 117-94 win. Oklahoma City's 108-101 win over the Clippers was the closest game, decided by seven points.

games.headline: Dončić scores 52 as Lakers beat Jazz 132-123
games.story: Utah led 47-29 after the first quarter, but Los Angeles outscored the Jazz 45-24 in the second and went to halftime ahead 74-71. The game was tied at 116 with 4:06 left, and the Lakers went ahead for good at 117-116 with 3:34 to play. Luka Dončić scored 52 on 17-of-30 shooting with eight three-pointers, 8 rebounds and 10 assists, and Austin Reaves added 29. Lauri Markkanen scored 28 for Utah and Keyonte George had 24 points and 10 assists.

games.headline: Pacers pull away from Nets, 136-109
games.story: Brooklyn led 26-24 after the first quarter, but Indiana scored 41 in the second and took the lead for good at 52-51 with 2:29 left in the half. The Pacers led 65-56 at halftime and outscored the Nets 37-24 in the third to go up 102-80. Their lead reached 27 at 131-104 with 2:16 to play. Tyrese Haliburton had 24 points and 10 assists, Pascal Siakam scored 21, and Nolan Traore led Brooklyn with 17.

games.headline: Gilgeous-Alexander's 34 lifts Thunder past Clippers
games.story: The game was tied 12 times and the lead changed hands nine times, with Oklahoma City up 77-76 after three. It was tied at 90 with 6:07 left, and the Thunder went ahead for good at 92-90 with 5:08 to play. Shai Gilgeous-Alexander scored 34 on 13-of-26 shooting and Ajay Mitchell added 18. Isaiah Hartenstein had 12 points and 12 rebounds. Darius Garland scored 16 with 11 assists for the Clippers, and Kris Dunn had 5 steals.

games.headline: Magic outscore Knicks 40-27 in fourth, win 111-102
games.story: New York opened on a 12-0 run and led 28-21 after the first quarter, and still held a 75-71 lead going into the fourth. Orlando scored 40 in the final period, tied the game at 91 with 5:12 left and went ahead for good at 94-91 with 4:53 to play. Franz Wagner had 23 points, 13 rebounds and 9 assists, and Desmond Bane scored 22. Jalen Brunson scored 28 for New York and Karl-Anthony Towns had 22 points and 14 rebounds.

games.headline: Timberwolves rout Raptors 117-94, lead by as many as 32
games.story: Toronto's only lead was 3-2 early in the first quarter. Minnesota led 32-21 after one and 90-62 after three, and its lead reached 32 at 109-77 with 4:46 left. Anthony Edwards scored 26 on 10-of-18 shooting, and LaMelo Ball had 15 points and 8 assists. Ja'Kobe Walter led Toronto with 22 points and five three-pointers, and RJ Barrett added 20.

games.headline: Pistons lead wire to wire, beat 76ers 106-93
games.story: Detroit scored the first points and never trailed. The Pistons led 34-22 after one quarter and by 21 at 56-35 late in the second. Philadelphia cut it to four at 79-75 early in the fourth quarter but got no closer. Cade Cunningham scored 26 with 8 rebounds and 8 assists, and Duncan Robinson added 21 with five three-pointers. Tyrese Maxey scored 29 for the 76ers, LeBron James had 18 and Jaylen Brown shot 5-of-20.

games.headline: Grizzlies beat Kings 123-112 behind Jerome's 31
games.story: Sacramento led 28-25 after the first quarter, but Memphis scored 42 in the second and led 67-59 at halftime. The Grizzlies led by 14 at 83-69 in the third, and after a 106-106 tie with 5:41 left they went ahead for good at 108-106 with 5:28 to play. Ty Jerome scored 31 for Memphis. Zach LaVine scored 37 on 13-of-25 shooting for Sacramento, and Domantas Sabonis had 15 points and 15 rebounds.
